<a id="saved_lantern_flags"></a>
### [`saved_lantern_flags`](../../../src/casbuf.asm#L7) `$0340-$03A0`

*variable*

Lantern flags of the waiting player: one byte per lantern record of all rooms (92 used), swapped with the live room lists by swap_player_lantern_flags.

- **Written by:** [`init_saved_lantern_flags`](game_vars.md#init_saved_lantern_flags) [`$0FE6`](../../../src/game_vars.asm#L71) (+95), [`init_saved_lantern_flags`](game_vars.md#init_saved_lantern_flags) [`$0FE6`](../../../src/game_vars.asm#L71) (+96)

### [`warm_start_flag`](../../../src/casbuf.asm#L30) `$03FF`
